Summary of the intended result (no workbook edited)
- B2 will be a true date value representing 2026-07-01 (date type, not text) and will display as 2026-07-01 (ISO-like yyyy-mm-dd).  
- F2 remains exactly =C2*D2 and continues to use the sheet's currency number format.  
- G2 remains exactly =IF(F2>1000,"Review","OK") and evaluates from F2 as before.  
- Any existing data validation on the Orders date cell(s) is preserved.

How to achieve this (platform‑agnostic, preserves formulas, validation and formatting)
1. Verify whether B2 is already a date value or text:
   - Put =ISNUMBER(B2) (Excel/Sheets) — TRUE means B2 is already a date serial/number; FALSE means it is text.
2. If B2 is already a date serial (ISNUMBER = TRUE):
   - Change only the number format: Select B2 (or the date column) → Format cells → Custom/Custom number format → enter yyyy-mm-dd (or your chosen standard). Nothing else changes (formulas, validation, currency, etc., are preserved).
3. If B2 is text (ISNUMBER = FALSE), convert to a date value without breaking validation or formulas:
   - Temporary/helper method (safe for Excel and Google Sheets):
     a. In a helper column (temporary), convert the text to a date value. Use a parsing approach that matches the text pattern "YYYY-M-D" (example formulas):
        - Google Sheets (recommended if many rows): =DATE(INDEX(SPLIT(B2,"-"),1),INDEX(SPLIT(B2,"-"),2),INDEX(SPLIT(B2,"-"),3))
        - Excel (quick for a single column): use Text to Columns (Data → Text to Columns → Delimited → Other: “-”), which yields three columns (year, month, day); then in the helper column use =DATE(yearCell,monthCell,dayCell).
        - Cross‑platform simpler formula (may work if the hyphen format is consistent): =DATEVALUE(SUBSTITUTE(B2,"-","/")) — this converts "2026-7-1" to a date serial in many locales; test on one row first.
     b. Confirm the helper cell shows a real date (or ISNUMBER(helperCell) returns TRUE). Format helper as a date to check.
     c. Copy the helper column → select B2 (or the original date range) → Paste special → Values only. Paste‑values replaces the text with the date serials but does not remove data validation rules on the destination cells.
